note: Roadmap §1.4 gate. Per-method reference top-K recall and ranking-score regret for the cross-method optimizer benchmark. The bench is bit-deterministic per seed (identical output at 2 and at all threads), so these tolerances absorb intentional optimizer changes, not measurement noise. Regenerate with `cargo xtask optimizer-bench-check --write-baseline` after an intentional change, and say why in the PR. KNOWN FINDING, not a passing grade: on this case at this budget the stratified random control reaches 0.0 score regret while tiered sits at ~0.0063, because the crews random samples are outside CrewGenerator's narrowed proposal space (see lane field `lane_best_crew_in_reference_set`). `control_margin` is set wide enough to tolerate that known gap so the gate still catches a further regression; closing the gap is tracked in docs/OPTIMIZER_AMBITIOUS_ROADMAP.md §1.4.
